# Cuoco

> AI-powered cooking companion app for iOS and Android

Cuoco is a mobile app that helps you discover, plan, and cook recipes using artificial intelligence and a built-in voice assistant. It is developed by Mark Berry, a sole trader based in the United Kingdom.

## What Cuoco does

Cuoco gives you a smart, hands-free cooking experience. You can talk to it while your hands are busy in the kitchen, import recipes instantly from photos or web links, and plan your meals for the week — all in one place.

## Key features

- **Voice assistant** — ask Cuoco questions, set timers, and get step-by-step guidance hands-free while you cook
- **AI recipe import** — import recipes from photos, URLs, or typed text; works with multi-page cookbook photos
- **Allergen detection** — automatically identifies allergens and dietary flags in any recipe
- **Nutritional information** — calculates macros and calories based on ingredients
- **Meal planner** — organise what you're cooking across the week
- **Cook Mode** — guided step-by-step cooking view optimised for use in the kitchen
- **Recipe collections** — save and organise recipes into personal collections

## Pricing

- Free 7-day trial — full access to all features, no card required
- Cuoco Core: £2.99/month — suitable for most users
- Cuoco Premium: £4.99/month — higher AI usage cap for heavy voice users
- Payments processed via Apple App Store

## Availability

- iOS (App Store) — coming soon
- Android (Google Play) — coming soon
